title: 第九章 小剑仙方少白第十章 王昱说酒
content_zh:
王昱不太熟练的拉住牛车，看向来人。
只见来人二十三四岁年纪，一身正青长衣略显凌乱，脸上带着洒脱不羁的神情，但此时正在努力挤出一丝和善无害的笑容。
见王昱看过来，他又把身后的长剑藏了藏。
这是一个很有意思的年轻人。
王昱眼神一闪，向来人招了招手，“上车吧。”
年轻人展露笑容，快步来到牛车旁边，先向车棚里的李云岫和紫菱行了一礼，这才跳上牛车，坐在了王昱的身边。
“多谢兄台！”年轻人对王昱道，“我拦了三辆车，只有你肯载我。”
王昱看向年轻人手边的剑，“出门在外，小心些也可以理解。”
这是一柄乌鞘长剑，剑柄上缠绕的棉绳已经被盘到油亮，皮质剑鞘上也有不少划痕，看起来很是陈旧。
年轻人随意的倚靠在车棚边上，笑着问道，“兄台不怕？”
“你若想害我，要么就不会把剑露出来，要么就直接拔剑了。”王昱摇头，然后露出一丝调侃的笑意，“说不得，让你上车，我还更安全一点呢。”
年轻人哑然失笑，然后举了举手中长剑，随口解释道，“师门所赐，总不能扔在道边。”
王昱道了声“理解”，然后问道，“我们要去西边的普宁县，你顺路吗？”
“巧了！我也正是要去普宁县。”年轻人飞快点头。
“那就顺路。”王昱挥起鞭子，让老黄牛再次启动。
……
此时春意正浓，即便是下午的阳光也透着一丝明媚，清风吹拂之下，令人身心舒适。
只是萍水相逢，王昱和年轻人也没通姓名，只是随口聊着。
王昱知道年轻人乃是本地人，此去普宁县乃是同门遇到了麻烦，赶去相助，年轻人也知道王昱乃是京畿道平津府人，此去西北乃是为父奔丧。
车棚里，紫菱不解的看向李云岫，不明白王昱为什么要邀请一个不知底细的江湖人上车，却不敢开口询问。

李云岫知道紫菱的疑惑，微微一笑，先是指指自己三人，比划了一个三，然后又指指年轻人，比划了一个四。
紫菱略有所悟，然后颇为佩服的看向王昱。
此时距离他们化妆潜行已经过了三天，路上的杀手想必早已知道了消息，除了放弃的之外，肯定还有其他人守在通往陇山府的交通要道上。
前面的普宁县，就是从严老中毒而死的陆家集前往陇山府的其中一条道路重镇，说不得其中就有不死心的杀手关注着来往旅客。
无论他们再怎样乔装打扮，也是一男两女的组合，而且年龄差距也不会太大，毕竟就算李云岫能将三人化妆成老人，他们也模仿不出老态龙钟的状态，反而容易露馅。
所以王昱路上再邀请一两个人，最好还是本地人，反而有利于他们蒙混过关。
唯一令李云岫有些不安的是，王昱邀请的是一个江湖人，而不是她想象中的货郎脚夫或手艺人之类的普通人。
当然了，其实江湖人也好，正所谓灯下黑，说不定本地江湖人反而不易引起注意，不过前提是他们不会在这个本地江湖人的面前暴露。
正所谓天下没有十全十美的好事，享受其利，就要承受其弊。
李云岫看向车外的两人，一个风趣幽默，一个自然洒脱，王昱说起平津府见闻头头是道，年轻人听说王昱七八年没有返回家乡，也说了些西北的道路风俗。
就在这时，前方路边出现了一杆旗幡，上面写了个“茶”字，却是一间开在道左的茶摊。
content_en:
Wang Yu pulled the ox cart unskillfully and looked at the person coming.
I saw that the person who came was about twenty-three or four years old. He was dressed in a slightly messy long green dress and had a free and uninhibited expression on his face, but he was trying hard to squeeze out a kind and harmless smile.
Seeing Wang Yu looking over, he hid the long sword behind him.
This is a very interesting young man.
Wang Yu's eyes flashed and he waved to the person coming, "Get in the car."
The young man smiled and hurried to the side of the bullock cart. He first saluted Li Yunxiu and Ziling in the shed, then jumped onto the bullock cart and sat next to Wang Yu.
"Thank you, brother!" the young man said to Wang Yu, "I stopped three cars, and you were the only one willing to take me."
Wang Yu looked at the sword in the young man's hand, "It's understandable to be careful when you go out."
This is a long sword with a black scabbard. The cotton rope wrapped around the hilt has been coiled until it is shiny. There are also many scratches on the leather scabbard, making it look very old.
The young man leaned casually on the edge of the carport and asked with a smile, "Brother, are you not afraid?"
"If you want to harm me, you either don't show your sword, or you just draw it." Wang Yu shook his head, and then showed a teasing smile, "I can't tell you, I will be safer if you get in the car."
The young man laughed dumbly, then raised his long sword and explained casually, "What is given by the master should not be thrown away by the roadside."
Wang Yu said "understood" and then asked, "We are going to Puning County in the west, are you coming along?"
"What a coincidence! I'm going to Puning County too." The young man nodded quickly.
"Then let's go." Wang Yu waved his whip and asked the old scalper to start again.
…
Spring is in full swing at this time, even the afternoon sun is shining brightly, and the breeze blows, making people feel comfortable both physically and mentally.
It was just a chance encounter. Wang Yu and the young man didn't know each other's names, so they just chatted casually.
Wang Yu knew that the young man was a local, and that he was going to Puning County because his fellow disciples were in trouble, so he rushed to help. The young man also knew that Wang Yu was from Pingjin Prefecture, Gyeonggi Province, and that he was going to the northwest to attend the funeral of his father.
In the carport, Zi Ling looked at Li Yunxiu in confusion. She didn't understand why Wang Yu invited a Jianghu man who didn't know the details to get on the car, but didn't dare to ask.
Li Yunxiu knew Zi Ling's doubts, smiled slightly, first pointed at the three of them and made a three, then pointed at the young man and made a four.
Zi Ling had some realization, and then looked at Wang Yu with admiration.
At this time, three days had passed since they disguised themselves and went stealth. The killers on the road must have already known the news. Apart from those who gave up, there must be others guarding the traffic artery leading to Longshan Mansion.
Puning County in front is one of the important towns on the road from Lujiaji, where Mr. Yan died of poisoning, to Longshan Prefecture. It is impossible to say that there are killers who are unwilling to give up and pay attention to the passengers.
No matter how they disguise themselves, they are still a combination of one man and two women, and the age gap is not too big. After all, even if Li Yunxiu can make the three of them look like old people, they will not be able to imitate their senility, and will easily reveal their secrets.
Therefore, inviting one or two more people on Wang Yu Road, preferably locals, would help them get through.
The only thing that made Li Yunxiu a little uneasy was that Wang Yu invited a man from the world, not an ordinary person like a porter or craftsman as she imagined.
Of course, in fact, whether it is a Jianghu person, as the saying goes, it is dark under the light, and the local Jianghu people may not easily attract attention, but the premise is that they will not be exposed in front of this local Jianghu person.
As the saying goes, no good thing in the world is perfect. To enjoy its advantages, you must bear its disadvantages.
Li Yunxiu looked at the two people outside the car. One was humorous and the other was natural and free. Wang Yu talked about what he had seen in Pingjin Mansion. The young man heard that Wang Yu had not returned to his hometown in seven or eight years, and also talked about some road customs in the northwest.
At this moment, a flag streamer appeared on the road ahead., the word "tea" is written on it, but it is a tea stall opened on the left side of the road.
